stops.note: a compound describing the large wildcat, later corrupted through transmission
adopted by Portuguese colonists in Brazil, later blended with a Guarani word for the animal
corrupted in French natural history writing, notably by Buffon
borrowed from French into English natural history usage
stops.meaning: a large wild cat native to the Americas, also called puma or mountain lion

current_meaning: a large, tawny wild cat native to the Americas, also known as the puma or mountain lion
